news.title: Infantino accused of killing football in anti-Fifa fan banner
news.lede: Fifa president comes under fire from Lyon ultras as he fights to save his job following failed attempt to sell stakes in World Cup. Gianni Infantino was labelled an “assassin” and Fifa a mafia group on Tuesday night as the fallout from his botched World Cup plan escalated. Members of the Lyon fan group, the Bad Gones, hung an anti-Infantino banner during their Champions League qualifier against Sparta Prague. The banner was unfurled at the Virage Nord inside the Groupama Stadium in France, where Lyon won 3-0 to complete a 4-2 aggregate win.

news.title: Cristiano Ronaldo announces marriage to Georgina Rodriguez in Portugal
news.lede: The 2026 World Cup exit for Portugal was believed to be the end of Cristiano Ronaldo’s international career. The Portuguese captain became the only player to score in six World Cups after his brace against Uzbekistan.

news.title: NZ Football to send team to U20 World Cup despite calls for Fifa boycott
news.lede: New Zealand Football has committed to sending a team to the Fifa Under-20 Women’s World Cup, despite calls to boycott the competition. The tournament in Poland is the first Fifa competition since Uefa member associations unanimously supported a boycott of events staged by football’s global governing body because of plans by Fifa president Gianni Infantino to sell commercial rights in its competitions to private investors. New Zealand Football confirmed to Reuters a team will be sent despite the backlash against Infantino. “New Zealand Football is sending a team to the U20 Fifa Women’s World Cup in Poland next month.
